Activity.description: Represents a single activity in the trip schedule.

hasPodcast.description: Flag indicating if a historical podcast should be generated for this site
hasPodcast.title: Haspodcast

podcast_url.description: URL pointing to the generated TTS audio file
podcast_url.title: Podcast Url

podcast_brief.description: Short historical/contextual brief about the site, narrated in the podcast in addition to 'desc'
podcast_brief.title: Podcast Brief

map_coordinates.description: Dictionary with 'lat' and 'lng' keys for map rendering
map_coordinates.title: Map Coordinates

price.description: Cost of this activity, in the trip's currency
price.title: Price

url.description: Link to the activity's official site or listing
url.title: Url

directions_car.description: Driving directions/notes to reach this activity from the previous stop
directions_car.title: Directions Car

directions_transit.description: Public-transit directions/notes to reach this activity from the previous stop
directions_transit.title: Directions Transit

map_url.description: User-supplied Google Maps link that overrides the one built from 'map_coordinates'. Never invent one — leave as given.
map_url.title: Map Url

travel_mode.description: How you get to this activity from the previous stop. A single day is routinely mixed (drive to a trailhead, hike, bus back). Null means the client infers it from the activity and the distance from the previous stop.
travel_mode.title: Travel Mode

Activity.title: Activity

ChecklistItem.description: One thing to bring/prepare, either for a single day or for the whole trip.
ChecklistItem.title: ChecklistItem

TripData.description: The complete trip model to be sent to the client application.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the dominant language of the trip's source text (e.g. 'he' if most words/verbs are Hebrew, 'en' if mostly English). All generated content and agent chat replies should match this language.
language.title: Language

photo_album_url.description: Link to a shared photo album for the whole trip
photo_album_url.title: Photo Album Url

checklist.description: Trip-wide essentials (passport, chargers) — things not tied to one day
checklist.title: Checklist

TripData.title: TripData

TripDay.description: Represents a full day in the trip.

checklist.description: What's needed for this specific day (boots for a trail day, swimsuit for a beach day)
checklist.title: Checklist

TripDay.title: TripDay

description: Structured response expected from the LLM during Stage 3 chat.

agent_reply.description: The friendly reply from the agent in Hebrew
agent_reply.title: Agent Reply

title: AgentResponse
